title: Ngā Kaiwhakaatu Pūmau
intro: Whakaarohia tētahi wā i whakamatautauria ai te whakapono ki te ahi, ā, ko te whakapono pumau te mea tino whakahē. Ko tāu mahi he hura i te tuakiri o tētahi rōpū e kōrerotia ana i roto i te Quran, he kōrero mō te whakapono hohonu ki te mana whakahaere kino. Wetekina ngā tohu kia kitea ai ko wai ēnei wairua, me ngā āhuatanga rerekē i pā ki a rātou.
clues: I tū pakari mātou ki tō mātou whakapono, ahakoa te kaha o te pēhanga ki te whakarērea tō mātou whakapono.
I whaia mātou e tētahi rangatira mana nui i whai ki te tineia te māramatanga o te whakapono ki te atua kotahi.
I kite mātou i ngā tohu nunui me ngā merekara, heoi i noho mangere tonu ō mātou kaitukino.
I whakamanawanui mātou i tētahi tikanga whakatoi whakamataku i hangaia hei whakawehi i ētahi atu kia ngohengohe.
I maka mātou ki roto i te mura ahi, heoi nā tō mātou manawanui i whiwhi ai mātou i tētahi tūranga teitei i te aroaro o Allah.
Kei roto i tētahi Surah, i tapaina i muri i ngā whetū o te rangi, te kōrero mō te mutunga o te hunga e whakatoi ana i te hunga whakapono.

trial.label: Tō tātou whakatoi
options: Te toremitanga i roto i te waipuke
E kainga ana e te hau werawera
Te maka ki roto i te awaawa mura
trial.answer: Te maka ki roto i te awaawa mura

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He awaawa hohonu, e mura ana
location.answer: He awaawa hohonu, e mura ana

outcome.label: Tō tātou mutunga mutunga
options: I whakawhiwhia rātou ki tētahi rangatiratanga i runga i te whenua.
I whakaorangia rātou e tētahi mawhiti whakamiharo.
I whiwhi rātou i te mate whakamate me te utu mutunga kore.
I hurihia rātou hei momo rerekē.
I hoatu ki a rātou te taonga nui me te angitu nui.
outcome.answer: I whiwhi rātou i te mate whakamate me te utu mutunga kore.

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
